videos.caption: A hawk was out yesterday, circling right over my run, and my chickens knew it before I did.  One of them gave the alarm, their chicken scream and the whole flock froze, just like statues, not a one of them moving. Chickens have a warning call for danger from above, and when the rest of the flock hears it, they go still or run for cover.  Going still is how they stay safe, a hawk hunts by movement, so no movement means no target. That is why I keep bird netting over the top of my run. A hawk cannot swoop down in if there is netting in the way, and my chickens have places to hide underneath it too.  Hawks are protected, so you cannot just get rid of them, the answer is keeping your flock covered. Have you ever watched your whole flock freeze all at once like that? Have you  heard the chicken scream? #hawks #chickens #protection #homestead #simpleliving
